shape: 3-portal sprawling arena (S+W+E gates) with central + south super-hubs
description: Three-portal arena split into south clique, west arm, and south-east cluster, joined by two interior super-hubs. The CENTRAL anchor (d23dbe at (-4.57, -1.69)) is a 4-way junction that fans west, south, east-of-center. The SOUTH super-hub (wz6sk3 at (2.06, -6.65)) is a 6-way junction wired to most of the east/south cluster. The SOUTH clique (vrl6ns + xmh9aj + dfzp33 + rau5rt + 61dou8) is densely interconnected near the south gate. The WEST arm (fqrgxy → irrdxp + 2j58hb) reaches the west gate via a short chain. Largest valley-B stage authored.

south clique south-west — bridge to center (matches dfzp33)

traversalNotes: Direct south ↔ east: spawn_south → south_inner → south_sw → center → south_hub → east_inner → spawn_east. 6 hops via the two super-hubs.
Direct south ↔ west: spawn_south → south_inner → south_sw → center → center_w → west_inner → spawn_west. 6 hops.
Direct west ↔ east: spawn_west → west_inner → center_w → center → south_hub → east_inner → spawn_east. 6 hops via center + south_hub.
DISPATCH RULE: center is the canonical west↔east router; south_hub is the canonical south-cluster dispatch (6 detours).
South clique (south_inner + se_corner + south_c + south_w + south_sw) is densely interconnected — BFS will find short paths inside it.
south_pocket is a single-degree dead-end off east_s (likely a corner objective).
